name: Mibefradil

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1998 — for heart harm and muscle and bone problems

summary: Mibefradil was removed from the market worldwide starting in 1998 due to harm to the heart as well as muscle and bone issues [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on real people, gave this medicine a medium score of 55 for liver problems [M]. The same computer model also assigned it a high score of 76 for heart problems [M].
